findings: SEC filings establish Coinbase Custody, Coinbase Inc and Coinbase Credit roles in Bitwise XRP ETF: custodian, Prime Execution Agent and secured trade-credit lender.
Bitwise trade credits may be cash or XRP, secured by first-priority liens over the Trust Trading Balance and XRP Account; Agent Execution Model is rare and actual usage/amount unknown.
Coinbase was Bitwise's principal market for GAAP NAV at June30 2026; this is fund-specific.
Coinbase appears in the custodian set of five of six US spot XRP ETFs; those funds held 1.1422B XRP at Oct30, but actual Coinbase allocation is unknown.

Ripple Markets purchased 10M 21Shares initial ETF shares for $220.676M on Dec20 2024; this is ETF-share capital, not proof of equivalent spot XRP purchase. The two-year share restriction date is Dec20 2026, plus six months after listing.

Bitwise H1 2026 net XRP inventory increase was approximately +155.615M; 21Shares H1 net XRP inventory change was approximately -27.303M and net cash capital transactions -$49.501M, while Q2 alone was +$3.702M net cash and +2.455M XRP inventory.
XRP Insights methodology shows 48.4% cold, 14% hot, 37.8% unclassified, 487.2M non-customer reserves, no per-wallet history and a 1.6M Binance-Peg discrepancy.
